facts.text: Deborah reconnected with her mom's old friends, which evoked emotional responses and reminded her of her luck in having her mom.

evidence.quote: Since speaking last, I reconnected with my mom's old friends. Their stories made me tear up and reminded me how lucky I am to have had her.
Hearing stories about my mom was emotional. It was both happy and sad to hear things I hadn't heard before. It was a mix of emotions, but overall it was comforting to reconnect with her friends.
